title: REQ-097/REQ-098: executor must not run css:rebuild/assets:publish against HTTP-only remotes and must treat dist/.manifest.json 404 as arquivo-estatico fallback
trap: Executor runs c2f css:rebuild or c2f assets:publish against an HTTP-only remote (local: false, no SSH), ignores installation.dist (REQ-306), or treats HTTP 404 on dist/.manifest.json as a blocker instead of the arquivo-estatico fallback over gestor/.
